newsitem.title: USA: NGC closes merger with Chevron natgas unit.
newsitem.headline: NGC closes merger with Chevron natgas unit.

text.p: NGC Corp said its merger with Chevron Corp's Natural Gas Business Unit and Warren Petroleum Co closed Saturday following approval by NGC shareholders Friday.
The merger creates the largest natural gas and natural gas liquids marketer in North America, NGC said.

It said the merger increases NGC's natural gas marketing sales volumes to about 10 billion cubic feet daily from 6.0 billion cubic feet per day and virtually quadruples sales volumes of natural gas liquids to 470,000 barrels daily from 120,000 barrels per day.
NGC said Chevron receives some 38.6 million new NGC common shares and about 7.8 million shares of participating preferred stock in the new company.
Chevron also receives about $285 million in cash and notes, which takes into account certain purchase price adjustments contained in the merger documents announced in January.
Chevron, British Gas Plc and NOVA Corp now each own about 25 percent of NGC's common, the company said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
